messages:
maya_pm: Quick sync  proposing a micro-optin rollout for the regional fallback feature. Need signoff from ENG/SRE/DevEx.

chen_eng: What's the percent/regions/duration?

maya_pm: Plan: 0.5% cohort, start us-east-1, add us-west-2 after 24h if stable, eu-west-1 on day3. 24h baseline per region. AB inside cohort 50/50 fallback vs current.

noah_sre: Kill-switch? automation?

maya_pm: Flag: feature.fallback.micro_optin. Auto-failover on 3 consecutive 5m windows breaching gates (p50 +120ms, error_rate > 0.4%). Manual immediate rollback possible via shiproom. 15m cooldown after any auto action.

devex_riley: SDK flag name and console tile please so I can update UI. Also need telemetry keys.

maya_pm: SDK: feature.fallback.micro_optin, tenant holdout: fallback.tenant_holdout. Telemetry: fallback_reason, route_id, trace_link. Sample 0.2% payloads for offline eval.

deploy-bot: CI: pipelines/rollouts/micro_optin/1799999999 queued by @maya_pm. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/rollouts/1799999999

chen_eng: +1 from eng, will add preflight synthetic load (10m) and AB metric hooks.

noah_sre: +1 for SRE, will create monitors and dashboard tiles.

devex_riley: +1 for SDK/console updates. I'll draft tenant export format for exempt list.

maya_pm: thanks all, creating shiproom ticket with runbook and annotated rollout table. Ping here for urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
